ProductStory: Our Turtle Friendly Wildlife Lighting is crafted as a wall-mounted lantern, built from solid copper and designed to age gracefully with a natural patina. It provides electric illumination for everyday exterior use and complements both traditional and coastal architecture.  These fixtures elegantly combine the natural beauty of copper with the standards of low impact lighting. These lighting accessories are considered wildlife-friendly and have been approved for use in areas sensitive to the natural migration of sea turtles.    All wildlife-friendly products by The CopperSmith have been tested and certified by the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission as compliant with the artificial lighting standards established by the Wildlife Lighting Certification Program.
